get_minibatch_blob_names: get the blob names in order for the Detectron data loader based on the current model config
get_minibatch_construct: construct a minibatch sampled from a roidb with image blobs and region proposal data
get_minibatch_rpn: construct a minibatch for RPN or end-to-end Faster Mask R-CNN models from a roidb
get_image_blob: build an input blob from images in a roidb with random scale sampling and preprocessing
get_image_blob_flip: build an input blob from a roidb that supports image flipping and scale normalization
